episodes.title: You Have to Go Inside
episodes.summary: America's Child Psychologist, Mike Painter, returns to his long-unvisited home of Iron Hill, Ohio to look into a series of murders that occurred 30 years ago... and are connected to a children's television show, Candle Cove, that appears to be making a comeback.

episodes.title: I'll Hold Your Hand
episodes.summary: After Katie attacks her brother, Jessica asks Mike to talk to her daughter. Meanwhile, Mike remembers more of 1988 and tells Marla what he did.

episodes.title: Want to See Something Cool?
episodes.summary: Gary, Tim, and Daphne demand answers from Mike after they learn of his confession to Eddie's murder. Later, Mrs. Booth receives several visitors, and Lily arrives in Iron Hill.

episodes.title: A Strange Vessel
episodes.summary: When Mike realizes who is possessing Lily, he convinces Jessica to help him get his daughter back. Meanwhile, Amy investigates the four children and the trail leads her to Frances' house, and Jessica receives some visitors at home.

episodes.title: Guest of Honor
episodes.summary: Frances captures Marla and explains to Mike his role in what is to come... and what she has done for the sake of power.

episodes.title: Welcome Home
episodes.summary: When Eddie takes Lily, Mike has no choice but to enter the darkness and confront his twin brother... and the Skin-Taker.

episodes.title: This Isn't Real
episodes.summary: Margot Sleator lost her father a year ago. Now she, her friend Jules, their friend JD, and newcomer Seth venture into the No-End House, where visitors are challenged to face six rooms of increasing terror.

episodes.title: Nice Neighborhood
episodes.summary: Margot and Jules argue over whether the man who made them omelets is John. Meanwhile, JD meets his better self while Dylan is reunited with his wife.

episodes.title: Beware the Cannibals
episodes.summary: Margot flees from John when he turns violent. Meanwhile, JD rejoins the group, and Jules begins to lose memories of her childhood.

episodes.title: The Exit
episodes.summary: The group heads to the House, but John pursues them and only Margot and Jules make it there. To escape back to the real world, they must face their greatest fears.

episodes.title: The Damage
episodes.summary: The cannibal John follows Margot home and tries to make a deal with her so he can stay in the real world. Meanwhile, Jules discovers that she's lost the memories of her mother, and Corinne returns home to see the memory-cannibal wearing her dead husband's face.

episodes.title: The Hollow Girl
episodes.summary: One year after Margot reenters the House, Jules tracks it down and goes inside to get her friend. But the House isn't willing to let its food source depart.

episodes.title: Insidious Onset
episodes.summary: Alice and Zoe Woods move away from their mother to the city of Garret, and Alice takes a job as a social worker in "Butcher's Block", a rundown part of the city. She soon discovers a mystery when a mother and daughter disappear, and the mystery seems connected to nearby Medallion Park... which is haunted by a staircase that goes nowhere.

episodes.title: Father Time
episodes.summary: Zoe returns to the house strangely changed. Meanwhile, Luke arrests one of the Peaches, who has a snack in his cell. And Alice and Louise continue pursuing the mystery of the disappearances.

episodes.title: All You Ghost Mice
episodes.summary: After Zoe cuts her leg shaving, Alice takes her to the hospital. Louise, Luke, and Nathan go with her and encounter Robert.

episodes.title: Alice in Slaughterland
episodes.summary: Luke makes a critical mistake after taking Robert's body to Louise. Meanwhile, Alice goes through the door and tries to find Zoe, who is having lunch with the Peaches.

episodes.title: The Red Door
episodes.summary: Alice embraces the Peaches to avoid insanity, and Zoe tries to convince her to leave after learning that Izzy is "marked".

episodes.title: Sacrifice Zone
episodes.summary: The landlord makes his entrance, and nothing will be the same when the Peaches fail to present Izzy as the sacrifice. Despite Zoe's efforts, Alice looks into the God's universe.

episodes.title: Ashes on My Pillow
episodes.summary: Newlyweds move back into the home where they grew up, and find a mysterious door in the basement that opens up wife Jillian's suspicions that her husband Tom is having an affair.

episodes.title: Where Did You Sleep Last Night
episodes.summary: Jillian goes back to her childhood home, and then both her and Tom pay visits to their therapists.

episodes.title: Love Hurts
episodes.summary: After Jack pays another visit, Ian rescues Jillian and Tom and then tells Jillian what she has to do to control Jack.

episodes.title: Bizarre Love Triangle
episodes.summary: After instructing Jillian in how to uncreate Pretzel Jack, Ian meets with her father Bill.

episodes.title: You Belong to Me
episodes.summary: Tom learns the truth about Ian's father and reveals it to Jillian.

episodes.title: Two of Us
episodes.summary: Ian tries to make himself and Jillian an item, but Tom and Jack have other plans... and Tall Boy has plans for them.
